messages:
alex: PR #6120 needs a compact quickstart snippet that maps quota tiers to allowances and a one-line migration note for legacy meter headers. cc @nina @pete
nina: I can add a 4-line JS snippet + the migration sentence. Keep it customer-facing and tiny.
pete: I'll add a minimal alert YAML (percent_of_daily) and a short UX note about burst credits.
nina: Draft snippet:```js
// minutes -> floored allowance
const allowance = (per_min, mins) => Math.floor(per_min * mins);
console.log(allowance(250, 4)) // 1000
```
pete: Draft alert:```yaml
when: usage.percent_of_daily >= 75
window: 1h
action: notify:billing
notes: percent rounded to nearest int; burst credits excluded until consumed
```
alex: Migration one-liner to include: "Map legacy meter header to X-Redwood-Usage-Tier and recompute allowances from per_min/per_day." Also add: UI shows costs with two decimals; enforcement floors to whole tokens.
nina: Pushing to PR now and will ping @docs-bot for l10n. :rocket:
docs-bot: l10n-check queued for PR #6120. ETA ~8h :gear:
